**Do not use this template to request a patch.** To get fonts patched, open a **Font Patch Request** instead.

## What happened?

Describe the problem. Examples: the workflow never replied, the bot rejected my zip, the download link doesn't work, the patched font looks wrong.

## Where did it happen?

If you got a reply from the workflow, paste the link to your Font Patch Request here (just the URL, e.g. `https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/5`). If not, leave this blank.

## Steps to reproduce

What did you do before the problem happened?

## Expected result

What did you expect to happen instead?

## Device and Android version (if the problem is with a font)

## Module version (if the problem is with a font)

## Anything else

Attach your original zip or a screenshot if it helps.
